apiAuth.description: An agent token: `Authorization: Bearer hos_…`, created through `POST /v1/tokens`. Every endpoint also accepts the session cookie set by `POST /v1/auth/sign-in`, which is what the dashboard uses.

post.description: Called by an email provider or relay with the raw MIME message as the body. The recipient address picks the workspace. Replies are threaded onto their ticket using In-Reply-To and References. The content is stored as data and never acted on.

201.description: Stored as a new ticket or a reply

404.description: No workspace has this address. Nothing was stored

422.description: Not a usable email (e.g. no From address)

post.summary: Sign in with email and password
post.description: Starts a human session and sets it as an HttpOnly cookie. A wrong email and a wrong password get the same answer. There is no sign-up: users are created by the operator. Agents use tokens instead (`POST /v1/tokens`).

204.description: Signed in; the session cookie is set

403.description: Sent by a browser from another site (`forbidden_origin`)

503.description: Human sign-in isn't configured on this server

post.description: Ends the current session and clears its cookie. Safe to call without one.

403.description: Sent by a browser from another site (`forbidden_origin`)

503.description: Human sign-in isn't configured on this server

post.summary: Set a password with a one-time link
post.description: Uses the token from a password setup link (printed by `helpos:init`) to set the user's password, 12 to 128 characters. The token works once. Every existing session of that user is signed out.

204.description: Password set; sign in with it

400.description: The link is unknown, used or expired (`invalid_token`)

403.description: Sent by a browser from another site (`forbidden_origin`)

503.description: Human sign-in isn't configured on this server

get.description: The caller's identity, workspace and scopes. Works for sessions and tokens.

post.description: Creates a token for one agent, with exactly the scopes given. The response holds the token itself, the only time it is shown: store it right away. Needs a human session with `workspace:admin`; an agent token can't create tokens. A token can only get scopes its creator holds (`scope_not_held`).

403.description: Called with an agent token (`session_required`), or without `workspace:admin`

get.description: Every agent token, revoked ones too, oldest first. Never includes the tokens themselves. Needs a human session with `workspace:admin`.

403.description: Called with an agent token (`session_required`), or without `workspace:admin`

delete.description: Revokes a token at once: every later request with it gets 401. The token stays listed, so audit events still name it. Revoking a revoked token changes nothing. Needs a human session with `workspace:admin`, or the token itself: an agent can always revoke its own token, e.g. when it may have leaked.

403.description: Neither `workspace:admin` in a human session nor the token itself

get.description: The workspace's tickets, most recent activity first, at most `limit` (default 50, max 100). `status` keeps only open or only closed ones. Needs `tickets:read`.

403.description: The credentials lack `tickets:read`

get.summary: Read a ticket and its messages
get.description: One ticket with its emails, oldest first. Needs `tickets:read`.

403.description: The credentials lack `tickets:read`

post.description: Marks the ticket `closed` and audit-logs it. Closing a closed ticket changes nothing. Pending drafts are left as they are. Needs `tickets:write`.

403.description: The credentials lack `tickets:write`

get.description: Every AI draft on the ticket, oldest first. Needs `tickets:read`.

403.description: The credentials lack the required scope

post.summary: Write a draft, or ask the AI for a new one
post.description: Answers the ticket's latest customer message. With `body`, saves that text as a `pending` draft (201). With `regenerate: true`, queues a fresh AI draft (202): it appears in the list when ready. Either way, older pending drafts on the ticket are discarded. Nothing is sent until the draft is approved. Needs `drafts:write`.

202.description: An AI draft is being written

403.description: The credentials lack the required scope

409.description: No customer message to answer (`nothing_to_answer`), or the latest one already has an approved or sent reply (`already_answered`), or `regenerate` was asked after today's AI budget was spent (`daily_budget_reached`)

patch.description: Replaces the body of a draft that is still `pending`. Needs `drafts:write`.

403.description: The credentials lack the required scope

409.description: The draft is no longer pending

post.summary: Approve a draft and send it
post.description: Marks a `pending` draft `approved` and queues it to be sent, in one transaction. This is the only way a reply reaches a customer. Sending happens in the background: the draft becomes `sent` once the email is out, and a failed send is retried. The request carries the body the approver reviewed: if the draft was edited since, nothing is approved (409). Needs `drafts:approve`.

403.description: The credentials lack the required scope

409.description: The draft is no longer pending, or was edited since it was reviewed

post.description: Marks a `pending` draft `discarded`, so it can never be approved or sent. Use it for a draft that shouldn't go out. Needs `drafts:write`.

403.description: The credentials lack the required scope

409.description: The draft is no longer pending

get.summary: Today's AI usage for this workspace
get.description: Tokens the workspace's AI drafting used today (UTC), against its hard daily budget. At or over the budget, no model call is made and new tickets are marked `ai_paused_reason: daily_budget` until UTC midnight. Needs `tickets:read`.

403.description: Missing scope

get.description: Every knowledge source in the workspace, oldest first, with its ingestion status. Needs `knowledge:read`.

403.description: The credentials lack the required scope

post.description: Adds a web page (`kind: url`) or a markdown document (`kind: markdown`; to upload a file, send its text). It is ingested in the background: fetched through an SSRF-safe fetch, split into passages and embedded, which counts toward the daily AI budget. The status turns `ready` or `failed`. AI drafts then quote matching passages as reference data and record which ones they cite. One page per URL source: links are not followed. `slug` defaults to one made from the title. `visibility` defaults to `internal`. Needs `knowledge:write`.

visibility.description: `public` may be shown or cited to customers. `internal` (the default) is the team's own notes: AI drafts may follow it, but are told never to reveal it.
`public` may be shown or cited to customers. `internal` (the default) is the team's own notes: AI drafts may follow it, but are told never to reveal it.

403.description: The credentials lack the required scope

409.description: The workspace already has a source with this slug (`slug_taken`), or with this URL (`url_taken`, with its `sourceId`). URLs are compared without the fragment, host case or a default port.

post.description: Sets the source back to `pending` and queues it, e.g. after a `failed` ingest, after the page changed, or after the embedding model changed. Until the new ingest is done, drafts keep using the current passages. If it fails on a temporary problem (the site is down, the embedding call failed), they stay. If the page is gone (404, 410) or no longer usable (no text, too long, not a page), they're removed. Asking again while it's pending queues nothing new, but a request made during a fetch gets a fetch of its own. Needs `knowledge:write`.

403.description: The credentials lack the required scope

409.description: The source is managed in the workspace's git repo (`managed_in_git`): it's re-ingested on sync

delete.description: Deletes the source and its passages. Drafts written with it keep their copy of the passages they saw, with `sourceId` null. Needs `knowledge:write`.

403.description: The credentials lack the required scope

409.description: The source is managed in the workspace's git repo (`managed_in_git`): delete the file there

get.description: Whether replies go to the shadow recipient instead of customers. Needs `tickets:read`.

403.description: The credentials lack the required scope

patch.description: Sets the shadow recipient, or turns shadow mode on or off. Every change is audit-logged. Turning it off lets replies reach real customers, so it is refused (`shadow_mode_locked`) unless the server allows it. Needs `workspace:admin`.

403.description: The credentials lack the required scope

409.description: Turning shadow mode off is not allowed on this server
